name: Javanese canting wax-resist cloth
description: A 1901 letter describes Javanese women applying patterned wax with a canting to reserve parts of cloth from dye.

date.label: January 1901, dated letter
date.basis: Date of the scoped witness or archaeological context, not a claim of origin.

events.statement: Joza Šrogl described Javanese women using a spouted canting to apply wax to cloth in a letter written in January 1901.

evidence.supports: Šrogl’s January 1901 letter describes Javanese women applying wax with canting tools; an independent workshop photograph was bought in 1900.
